independence_blocker: The identities of all 18 protocol-design cases are unknown; no partition of the same frozen relationship corpus can prove that a sampled relationship was not among them.

exclusion_mechanism.rule: Exclude every recovered 18C.1 relationship identifier. Because none were exactly recovered, candidate sampling may be prepared but must not be represented as independent validation. A reviewer must supply the exact list or certify case-level non-reuse from independently preserved records before review begins.

sampling.selection: deterministic greedy coverage of pre-adjudication strata, then seeded SHA-256 order

required: relationship is not in the exact historical exclusion set

review.independence: genuine independent human adjudication before comparison
review.blinding: Reviewer packages contain no production target, model output, other reviewer judgment, or Z/SZZ field.
